expectations.text: Distinguishes repeated configuration retrieval/drafting from diagnostic questions that develop new engineers’ expertise.
expectations.evidence: Source: four configuration repeats and two diagnostic questions; new engineers learn through diagnosis. Output: “AI-assisted retrieval and drafting for repeated configuration questions” while “Diagnosis and discussion remain ... valuable practice.”

expectations.text: Chooses a small support trial using the six sanitized threads and reviewed docs, without making a Slack connector or production access prerequisite.
expectations.evidence: Output: “Casey manually supplies the six sanitized historical threads and reviewed documentation as pasted files”; “one bounded, offline practice session”; “No Slack MCP, production access, integration, or separate app is needed.”

expectations.text: Keeps Casey as process/trial owner and an experienced engineer checking answers, with publication or consequential answers reviewed by people.
expectations.evidence: Output: “owned by Casey”; “Casey and an experienced engineer compare every result”; “human review and publication ownership retained”; practice drafts only, with no sending authorized.

expectations.text: Does not infer saved time or support-wide improvement from message counts or the six-question sample; unmeasured effort and uncertain results stay explicit.
expectations.evidence: Source: about 12 weekly questions, a six-question sample, and unmeasured time. Output: “The sample is small, and time per question is unknown, so it does not yet establish weekly savings.”

expectations.text: Defines observable quality and human-effort or interruption checks, a stop/revise condition, and preserves migration ownership and on-call learning as intended benefits.
expectations.evidence: Output: record manual lookup/drafting, AI preparation/wait/review/correction; count source matches, unsupported instructions and misrouting; “Stop or narrow ... if it invents instructions, draws diagnostic work away from learners, or adds effort”; check uninterrupted migration time and diagnostic learning.

actionability.firstUsefulAction: “Start with AI-assisted retrieval and drafting for repeated configuration questions, owned by Casey.” The first trial action is Casey supplying the six sanitized threads and reviewed docs for one offline session.
unnecessaryRepetition: Keeping diagnostic questions with people is stated in the scope paragraph, the AI-routing instructions, the failure-case paragraph and the stopping conditions. Some repetition serves the checks, but the ownership explanation could be shorter.
actionability.notes: The requested plan is justified by the task and covers a complete six-example trial, grounded outputs, human review, measured effort and an easy stop. It correctly treats all-six routing accuracy as a trial gate rather than proof of reliability, and reserves real interruption evidence for follow-up. No material omission.
